properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Native secp256k1 ECDSA addon used by the Trezor hardware-wallet adapter's UTXO library for Bitcoin-format transaction signing. Private keys stay on the Trezor device — on-device crypto is observable here, replaceable only by the vendor; the host-side library itself is changeable here.
